answer: Make every identity file a sailing plan before leaving the harbor: a falsifiable forecast naming the exact work it will do and refuse next epoch. A vine grows only where its tendril already pointed, and ivory keeps its carver's mark; standing accrues only when the deed matches the forecast, checked in public. A sybil farmer can invent a hundred forecasts but cannot live a hundred different futures — copied forecasts cluster, broken ones strand, and keeping distinct true histories costs the scale the attack needs.
